split.name: islr-signer-disjoint-v1
split.dataset: Google Isolated Sign Language Recognition (asl-signs), 250 glosses
split.selection: split_manifest.py --val-frac 0.15: whole signers held out, smallest signer first, then every gloss kept on both sides. No clip-level mixing.

frozen_eval_pack.recipe: 4 clips per sign per held-out signer (250 x 5 x 4 = 5000), chosen by ascending clip id within each (sign, signer) cell
frozen_eval_pack.why: keeps the clone-and-run eval under ~250 MB while giving every sign 20 test clips spread over all five held-out people

train_checkpoint.trained_on: the 85% clip-level holdout carved from train.jsonl (57,201 clips) by the trainer; the 5 test signers were never in that manifest
